senses.gloss: शुन śuná, n. growth, prosperity, luck (V.): 🞄-m, ad. for growth or prosperity (V.).
शून 1. śūna, pp. (√ śvā) swollen.
शून 2. śū́na, (pp.) n. [swelling, hollowness: 🞄√ 2. śū] emptiness, lack, want.
शूना śūnā, f. incorr. for सूना sūnā.
सुन्न sunna, m. N..
सून sūna, n. [perh. sprout: old pp. √ 2. sū] 🞄blossom, flower: -śara, m. (flower-arrowed) 🞄god of love.

शुनंहवीया śunaṃ-havīyā, f. N. of RV. III. xxx, 22 (which commences with the words 🞄‘śunaṃ huvema’;
 Br.).
शुनःपुच्छ śunaḥ-puccha, m. (Dogʼs tail), N..

शुनक śuna-ka, m. (little) dog;
 N.: pl. descendants 🞄of Śunaka.
शुनंकुरि śunaṃ-kuri, m. kind of rural genius.
शुनपृष्ठ śuná-pṛṣṭha, a. having a suitable 🞄back (RV.¹).
शुनःशेप śúnaḥ-śépa, m. (Dogʼs tail), N..

शुनाशीर śúnā-śī́ra, m. du. N. of two genii 🞄favourable to the growth of grain (V.);
 m. 🞄sg. ep. of Indra (V., C.): -asana, n. (Indraʼs 🞄bow), rainbow.
शुनी śúnī, f. of śván.
शुनोलाङ्गूल śuno-lāṅgūla, m. (Dogʼs tail), N..
शुन्ध् ŚUNDH, v. शुध् ŚUDH.
शुन्ध्यु śundh-yú, a. (ū́) bright, beauteous 🞄(V.).

सुन्द sunda, m. ep. of Viṣṇu;
 N. of an 🞄Asura, brother of Upasunda.

सुन्वत् sun-v-át, pr. pt. √ 1. su;
 m. sacrificer 🞄of Soma.

सूनर sū-nára, a. (ī) glad, joyous (V.);
 delightful 🞄(RV.).

सूनिक sūn-ika, m. butcher;
 -in, m. id..
